problem: Collections can be published with blank descriptions, images, or SEO fields, leaving merchants without a focused catalog-level content readiness audit.
target_merchant: Stores with many collections that want a read-only worklist of collection content gaps before merchandising or SEO review.
first_release: Find missing collection images and SEO title or description fields.
Separate collections by observed content gaps.
Export a diagnostic CSV with direct Shopify Admin collection links.

evidence: Shopify Community posts repeatedly discuss missing or non-displayed collection descriptions.
Shopify Admin GraphQL 2026-10 exposes collection description, image, SEO metadata and collection queries under read_products.
